full_inspection: Compared all four native halves line by line, including both infinity glyphs, all formulas, the handwritten re, margins and each tiny mark noted in the original record. The words and formulas otherwise agree.
original_transcription_comparison: Compared both complete original transcriptions. Both originally express an unsupported hand/type doubt for the body infinity; the insertion re and archive14/90 are the substantive original differences.

entries.decision: correct the copy2 hand/type uncertainty to the observed typed glyph
entries.reason: The same regular paired-loop contour repeats in both impressions and has the same type construction as the footnote infinity.

entries.decision: retain copy1 trouvé as base and report the copy2 insertion
entries.reason: Copy2 has dark handwritten re with an insertion stroke above the start of trouvé; copy1 has no added letters there.

entries.decision: retain the definite comma and record the unresolved nearby points without assigning a further character
entries.reason: Copy2 has two small points immediately to the right of the comma, visible in the enlarged crop; copy1 does not. Their origin and textual value are unresolved, so the exact definite textual reading remains disque, in both.

entries.decision: retain both distinct archive foliations without author attribution
entries.reason: The lower-left handwritten numerals14 and90 are clearly legible.

copy2_annotations.text_fr: La copie 2 porte \inserted{re} au-dessus du début de « trouvé », donnant « retrouvé ».
copy2_annotations.text_en: Copy 2 has \inserted{re} above the beginning of “trouvé”, producing “retrouvé”.

copy2_annotations.text_fr: La copie 2 porte deux petites traces ponctuelles immédiatement à droite de la virgule après « disque ». Leur origine et leur valeur textuelle restent indéterminées; elles sont décrites comme traces, sans lecture en caractères ni attribution à une main.
copy2_annotations.text_en: Copy 2 has two small point-shaped traces immediately to the right of the comma after “disque”. Their origin and textual value remain unresolved; they are described as traces, without a character reading or attribution to handwriting.

copy2_annotations.text_fr: La copie 2 porte en bas à gauche la foliation manuscrite 90.
copy2_annotations.text_en: Copy 2 has the handwritten foliation 90 at the lower left.
